rule: Every completed buyer, supplier, or founder action can create a human-approved feedback event that improves the next recommendation without exposing private organization data.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, or payment-custody feedback route is created in phase one.
learning_principles: Observe real user outcomes before changing recommendation weight.
Keep private organization memory separate from aggregate network learning.
Use aggregate, non-customer-specific signals to improve other organizations.
Keep every AI suggestion human-approved before action.
Reduce recommendation weight when suggestions are ignored, rejected, stale, or contradicted by proof.
Never use payment custody, rental value, deposits, escrow, payouts, or booking commissions as a phase-one learning route.

learning_loops.observed_action: direct enquiry sent, supplier replied, buyer shortlisted, buyer ignored, or buyer captured demand
learning_loops.private_memory: buyer search intent, proof preference, supplier response pattern, and shortlist behavior inside the buyer organization
learning_loops.aggregate_signal: equipment category demand, region demand, proof trust trend, and supplier response reliability without customer-specific details
learning_loops.next_recommendation: rank verified and responsive suppliers higher for the next matching buyer query
learning_loops.human_approval: buyer still chooses whether to enquire, shortlist, widen search, or capture demand

learning_loops.observed_action: listing viewed, proof updated, lead answered, lead missed, subscription renewed, or listing archived
learning_loops.private_memory: yard freshness, proof quality, response speed, renewal exposure, and lead close pattern inside the supplier organization
learning_loops.aggregate_signal: category supply depth, proof readiness, response reliability, and listing freshness without exposing supplier playbooks
learning_loops.next_recommendation: suggest the next proof fix, listing update, or response action most likely to improve trust and lead quality
learning_loops.human_approval: supplier still chooses whether to update proof, renew listing, answer lead, or pause inventory

learning_loops.observed_action: supplier target contacted, proof gate passed, paid listing ARR moved, direct enquiry arrived, or launch go/no-go changed
learning_loops.private_memory: market wedge quality, supplier hunt response, proof density, ARR signal, and operator decision inside the founder organization
learning_loops.aggregate_signal: country/category opportunity, proof gap, demand-supply imbalance, and launch readiness without exposing organization-specific plans
learning_loops.next_recommendation: recommend the next country, category, supplier cohort, or proof gate to test before traffic scales
learning_loops.human_approval: founder still approves go/no-go, launch sequence, supplier hunt, and category expansion
